one_line: Guidewire and Deepgram acquire AI firms; NeuroXess raises BCI funds; OpenAI and Anthropic tighten safety.

themes.title: AI-focused acquisitions
themes.text: Guidewire announced a $1.7 billion cash purchase of underwriting AI firm Hyperexponential, while Deepgram bought Daily, the creator of the open‑source Pipecat voice AI framework.

stories.headline: Guidewire to acquire Hyperexponential for $1.7 billion in cash
Deepgram acquires Daily, keeping open‑source Pipecat framework intact

themes.title: NeuroXess secures Series B
themes.text: Chinese BCI startup NeuroXess raised RMB 700 million in a Series B round to fund multicenter trials, regulatory work and a new manufacturing plant.

stories.headline: NeuroXess raises RMB 700 million Series B to expand BCI trials and manufacturing

themes.title: DeepSeek releases Super‑Agent
themes.text: DeepSeek unveiled Super‑Agent, an MIT‑licensed open‑source prototype that monitors GitHub repositories and developer chats to suggest fixes or open pull requests automatically.

stories.headline: DeepSeek releases open‑source Super‑Agent, a proactive coding assistant prototype

themes.title: Safety and policy changes
themes.text: OpenAI combined usage limits for ChatGPT and Codex into a single quota and patched a HTML preview sandbox exploit, while Anthropic added a rule blocking AI‑generated video‑game cloning.

stories.headline: OpenAI merges usage limits for ChatGPT and Codex
OpenAI patches HTML preview exploit that let attackers hijack ChatGPT accounts
Anthropic adds rule to block AI-generated video game clones
